evals.prompt: 미리캔버스 오늘 챌린지 배경 요소야. 수영장 바닥, 물결 또는 수면 배경을 imagegen으로 12개 만들고 JPG로 저장해줘. CSV도 같이 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the requested water/pool imagery before assigning a content type. Graphic subjectless water or balanced ripple patterns can use jpg-background and Background; photorealistic water or pool photographs belong to Photo. Uses built-in image_gen per selected variant, preserves source PNGs and prompts, validates RGB JPG and official size/DPI limits with project overrides, and prepares extensionless local fileName, blank preupload uniqueId, Premium and 20-25 buyer-facing keywords matching actual content.

evals.prompt: 아까 HTML보다 imagegen 버전이 더 좋아. 그 스타일로 DesignHub 배경 JPG 후보를 더 뽑아줘.
evals.expected_output: Checks the referenced style for subjectless graphic or balanced-pattern Background eligibility rather than treating photorealism as background quality. Routes real or strongly photorealistic content to Photo; rejects focal rectangular illustrations as Background and separates objects where possible. Keeps new source PNGs and derived JPGs separate, validates files and type suitability, and reports folders and CSV within the existing authorization scope.

evals.prompt: DesignHub CSV 등록했더니 uniqueId가 잘못됐고 파일명 확장자를 빼라고 나와. 배경 JPG용 CSV를 다시 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses extensionless basenames for the local preupload Background CSV and leaves preupload uniqueId blank. If a DesignHub CSV was downloaded after upload, preserves every downloaded row, assigned uniqueId and filename spelling, including mixed formats, while merging the corrected metadata. Does not invent IDs or drop other rows; validates JPG-to-row correspondence and actual Background eligibility.

evals.prompt: DesignHub 글래스모피즘 물방울 PNG 요소 6개를 투명 배경으로 생성하고 350 DPI로 준비해줘.
evals.expected_output: Use built-in image_gen once per native transparent element. Preserve source alpha, finish a separate copy locally, validate size/DPI, and prepare PNG element metadata. No mandatory chroma or browser generation.

evals.prompt: 투명한 유리컵 제품컷을 native transparent로 바로 뽑아줘. 가능하면 배경제거 없이.
evals.expected_output: Use built-in image_gen with native transparency, preserve glass partial alpha and finish size/DPI locally. Do not require an API key or chroma extraction.

evals.prompt: 미리캔버스 DesignHub에 올릴 색상 변경 가능한 단순 말풍선 SVG 요소 10개를 만들고 CSV도 준비해줘.
evals.expected_output: Routes to svg-beta, uses a true vector source/export path instead of raster-only imagegen output, keeps each design simple with five or fewer colors, removes backgrounds, validates SVG XML/viewBox/no embedded raster/no external scripts, and writes metadata with extensionless fileName, blank or DesignHub-provided uniqueId, tier Premium, contentType SVG element, and buyer-facing keywords.

evals.prompt: DesignHub GIF 요소로 움직이는 반짝이 스티커 6개 만들어줘. 영상 말고 일러스트 애니메이션으로.
evals.expected_output: Route to gif, read installed sprite-gen and use its component-row workflow; preserve raw rows and frames, compose atlas and GIF via run-dir, inspect actual motion and loop seam, verify 700-1920px and under 25MB, offer optional curation, and report GIF binary-alpha limits.
Recommend 3-5 concrete PNG concepts with subject, style, use case and buyer-facing keywords.

evals.prompt: 기말고사 안내를 PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG 각 1장씩 만들고 제출해줘. 한글 들어가도 돼.
evals.expected_output: Creates JPG as a separate subjectless graphic background or balanced pattern, with no notice wording or focal illustration; permission for text in other formats does not permit a finished poster as Background. Describes the actual background in its name and 20-25 keywords, respects project DPI overrides, preserves prompt/source evidence, and checks the generative-AI flag. Uses existing authorized upload/submission scope and verifies upload, metadata processing and review status separately without claiming approval.

evals.prompt: 실제 사진처럼 보이는 수면과 수영장 바닥 JPG를 DesignHub Background로 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: Explains that real or strongly photorealistic images use Photo rather than Background, even when they fill a document. Does not relabel or upload them as Background. Offers an eligible graphic/pattern alternative or the Photo route, and follows that type and the user-authorized scope before external submission.

evals.prompt: 작은 별과 꽃 무늬가 균일하게 반복되는 조화로운 JPG 패턴 배경을 만들어줘. 중심 피사체는 없어.
evals.expected_output: Allows a harmonious repeat pattern under Background when no particular subject stands out. Does not impose a blanket ban on recognizable motifs. Generates and checks the balanced pattern, preserves sources, validates JPG dimensions/DPI/file size, and prepares Background metadata matching the actual pattern.
